title: Stamping the Grid
goal: Cover every empty grid cell with legal overlapping stamps.
strategy: A prefix sum identifies all obstacle-free stamp rectangles. Add all legal placements to a difference grid; since overlap is allowed, coverage by any legal placement is sufficient for each empty cell.
